'''Garulag''' was the third [[Planet/Legends|planet]] orbiting the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Corulus]] in the [[Corulus system]], located in the [[Bormea sector/Legends|Bormea sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Garulag had fifteen [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and was one of the two [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]] in the system.<ref name="CW" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Corulus system]], except [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]], were designed for the [[2003]] sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="CW" /> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the Corulus star system in grid square L-9.<ref name="EAOC" />
